scope: Adopted canonical neutral, original6, expanded27, eyecatch18, prime18. Source art and physical target430 comparisons; episode scheduling and decoded film quality are reviewed by separate agents. No generation or source/catalog/tool mutation.

bear_baseline.basis: tools/render_counting_video.py and corresponding registrations, rather than unadopted new Bear stock.

keep.prime18: Crisp at430; same watercolor/palette/species/cream pouch and muzzle. Existing generated face keys are enough for normal blink/mouth reaction. Do not regenerate all assets solely to increase repertoire count.
keep.original6: Consistent species/canonical style and target-scale linework; individual reactions remain usable, but these six alone are not continuous wave/clap/posture sequences.

rest_posture_interval.assessment: Clear actual bends, seated weight and raised-arm stretch. Slightly softer than prime group at1.105× target scale, still usable after native scene transition review. Keep the postures group common scale; do not enlarge seated bbox.
rest_posture_interval.note: A new HQ rest sheet is an optional quality consistency improvement, not required just because of scale>1.

expressive_reactions.assessment: Useful for sparse context-specific reactions. Whole-key changes include expression/proportion shifts, so avoid constant alternation that makes face/body pump.

wave_alternative.assessment: Contains clearer palm-direction contrast than near-identical prime wave_raise/wave_right, but introduces a different drawing group. Prefer one coherent group per short cycle and review neutral entry/return.

optional_bow.assessment: Real torso bend; can support closing acknowledgement. Not essential for prime instruction. Retain head-calibrated group scale.

right_facing_board_gaze.issue: The face/muzzle turns viewer-right. Prime main board is viewer-left, so this is semantically the wrong attention direction. Do not mirror whole animal as a shortcut because tail and handedness swap.

fast_clap_from_stock.issue: The contact/cheer key has closed eyes, while clap_open has open eyes and a different smile. Rapid repeated two-key loop would flash face as well as hands. Need a coherent same-face hand cycle if using repeated applause.

tea.issue: Drawings are usable with the cup already present; no neutral-to-cup pickup/put-down transition. Do not pop a cup in/out merely to increase animation count.

dance.issue: Whole torso/head direction and foot stance change strongly. This can work as a deliberate closing gag but is less tied to the factor examples, and is distracting as continuous counting idle.

minimal_new_generation_recommendation.priority: One HQ six-cell group for missing semantic hand acting while keeping current prime18.
constraints: Reference canonical neutral AND current prime neutral for target body/head/palette match.
Same head, torso, feet, tail, eyes and closed-mouth smile for all six; change arms/hands only.
Large 3x2 cells, genuine transparent margins, complete tail and ears, no duplicate limbs.
One standing reference per sheet and anatomical foot support; no per-pose fit.
If two gesture families differ in face/body geometry, regenerate targeted cells instead of hiding the mismatch with body-scale normalization.
optional: HQ rest group if parent chooses to preserve prime-sized sharpness in all posture phases.
If a seated board gaze is desired, generate viewer-left gaze matching the seated base; current right-facing stock is unsuitable.

selection_judgment: The stock is sufficient to add one quiet seated/stretch interval without blanket regeneration. The current prime-specific repertoire still lacks the semantic presentation sequence and a same-face clap cycle found by comparison to richer Bear acting; these are focused material gaps, distinct from numerical/media correctness.
